connector.name: Plugin
connector.registryDescription: Circulara Observe MCP plugin - meters your AI agents' token spend and carbon, free tier.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package plugin. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.circulara. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
